verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers DGX B200 hardware, system administration, health monitoring, and container tooling (Docker/NVIDIA Container Toolkit), but contains no documentation of official SDKs (e.g., CUDA, cuDNN, TensorRT, NIM APIs) that AI-native developers would build against. Building against SDKs is a fair and applicable axis for an NVIDIA AI hardware platform, but nothing in this pack demonstrates it.
